entries.title: 用剧照截图当参考图生成角色设定图（H3 对比 GPT）
entries.note: 需配参考图（角色截图），提示词里用 <Picture 1> 等占位；图为 H3 Image 与 GPT Image 2.5 的对比。
entries.prompt: The character shown in <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> and <Picture 4> is <Subject 1>; <Picture 4> shows the character's whole figure from head to feet. The target image is a new 16:9 anime character model sheet of <Subject 1> on a clean white background, in the line art and shading style of the reference pictures. <Subject 1> is partially preserved; the face, eyes and eye colour, hair, head features, accessories, every part of the outfit from head to feet, and all of their colours and details remain exactly as they appear in the reference pictures, while the pose, scale, lighting and setting change. The character is drawn in neutral, even daylight colours on white, without the lighting, shadows or colour cast of the scenes in the reference pictures. At the top left the large title "NAME" sits in bold purple serif lettering above a thin purple rule, with the subtitle "Character Sheet" in smaller purple serif text beneath it. The left two-thirds of the sheet holds a row of three large full-body views of the character at the same scale, filling the full height of the sheet below the title, labelled above in small purple serif text "Front", "Side" and "Back", standing in a relaxed neutral pose with the arms down and the hands empty, each view showing a different side of the body from head to feet. The front view faces the viewer directly. The side view is a true left profile, the whole body turned ninety degrees to face screen left. The back view shows the character from directly behind, the face not visible at all. The right third holds two tall panels stacked to the full height of the sheet and framed by thin purple lines: an upper one labelled "Face Close-up (Front)" with a large front view of the head and shoulders, and a lower one labelled "Eye Close-up" with one of the character's own eyes drawn large. Generous white space and aligned baselines keep the sheet orderly.

entries.author: socialwithaayan
entries.title: 一句提示词生成洪水街道的开放世界犯罪游戏截图
entries.prompt:
Ultra-photoreal next-gen open-world crime game screenshot, captured in-game from a third-person chase camera, indistinguishable from real engine footage. A dynamic weather event in full force.

SCENE: A fictional Florida coastal city during hurricane landfall. The beachfront boulevard is flooded waist-deep with churning brown seawater. Palm trees are bent almost sideways with fronds ripping off, sheets of horizontal rain cut across the frame, traffic lights swing wildly on their wires, and a hotel awning tears loose. Parked cars float and bump into each other, a lifeguard tower has toppled into the street, and waves crash over the seawall, sending white spray three stories high. Pastel art deco hotels line the street with boarded-up windows and storm shutters. A police SUV with flashing lights is stuck in the water, and a news helicopter fights the wind overhead.

PLAYER: Center-lower frame, large and close to camera, riding a white jet ski at full speed down the flooded boulevard, carving a huge rooster tail of spray. Seen from behind: soaked black hoodie, life vest, one arm raised. Face not visible.

GAMEPLAY HUD (minimal): small rounded minimap bottom-left with a blue flooded overlay and a route line, thin health bar, a small storm icon top-right, five wanted stars with two lit.

PEAK REALISM: Rain droplets on the camera lens, foam and floating debris (coolers, beach chairs, palm fronds, a pink flamingo float), oil sheen on the water, reflections of flashing lights on the wet surfaces, wind-whipped clothing, realistic water simulation with wakes and splashes.

LIGHTING: Dark green-grey storm sky, a break in the clouds letting one shaft of light hit the skyline, flashing red and blue police lights, lightning branching over the bay.

CAMERA: Low third-person chase camera at water level, 28mm, motion blur and spray at the edges, 16:9.

RENDER: Next-gen AAA, path-traced lighting, 4K native, filmic grade, subtle grain.

AVOID: real game logos or titles, real brands, readable signs, faces close to camera, cartoon look, watermarks.

entries.author: 0xbisc
entries.title: 手绘毡笔风角色自定义游戏界面
entries.note: 需配角色参考图。
entries.prompt:
Create a square 1:1 hand-drawn character customization game interface, resembling a charming homemade early-2000s character creator webpage illustrated with black felt-tip pens on pure white paper. Use the uploaded character image as the sole character reference, preserving its exact appearance, proportions, silhouette, facial features, hairstyle, expression, pose, clothing, accessories, weapons, original rendering style, and complete color palette. Never redesign, simplify, stylize, recolor, or desaturate the character.
A slightly crooked, rounded black rectangular border encloses a very pale neutral-gray browser window occupying most of the canvas, surrounded by pure white. The handwritten title reads "custom chara maker", with three small window controls on the right. Below are three uneven square buttons labeled "BACK", "FORWARD", and "HOME", a long address bar displaying exactly "https://t.co/CHlw0l6KwF", and a small black square with white doodled stars.
Maintain a fixed two-column layout with a 42% left column and a 53% right column. The left contains "SPECIES" and "ITEM" selectors, each with left and right arrow buttons surrounding a small matching doodle of the character's species or distinctive visible accessory. Below are narrow dropdowns labeled "FAV COLOUR:" and "ALIGNMENT:", followed by a large "BIO:" box containing a short, playful biography arranged across four or five compact handwritten lines. Automatically generate all character information from the uploaded image's visible features, equipment, and apparent personality, avoiding unrelated lore. All text and selected values must be black. Use generous, consistent spacing between controls.
The right column contains a tall pure-white character preview panel with a slightly crooked black border, displaying the complete uploaded character centered from head to feet with comfortable margins. Directly beneath it, place a small pencil icon and a long name field containing a short imaginative character name. The character is the ONLY colored element in the entire image, retaining its exact original colors, details, and visual style without any grayscale filter, ink treatment, or paper texture applied to it.
Render the interface as an authentic scanned handmade indie game illustration, with moderately bold, uneven black felt-tip outlines, subtle wobbles, overlapping pen strokes, imperfect corners, organic line-weight variation, softened ink edges, and microscopic ink absorption into paper fibers. All lettering must be individually handwritten with a fine black pen: small, casual, rounded, slightly awkward lowercase-inspired characters, irregular letter widths and spacing, gently wandering baselines, and consistent handwriting throughout. Headings are slightly larger than field values, while the biography uses compact handwriting. Preserve readable text, consistent typography scale, and natural handmade imperfections.
Use strictly pure white, black, and neutral gray for the entire interface, with a very pale neutral-gray window and pure-white preview panel. Apply extremely fine, evenly distributed analog scan grain, subtle paper-fiber texture, and delicate microscopic ink-edge noise to the interface only, visible at close inspection without obscuring text or introducing colored noise.
Strictly preserve the specified layout, element positions, proportions, field sizes, and typography hierarchy across generations. No rearranged or missing sections, extra panels, colored interface elements, digital fonts, smooth vector lines, perfect geometry, polished modern UI styling, glossy shading, decorative gradients, heavy grain, or monochrome character rendering.

entries.author: aimikoda
entries.title: 整页日式漫画参数化提示词模板
entries.note: 把 VARIABLES 里的题材、角色、版式等换成自己的内容；四张图是不同题材的结果。
entries.prompt:
Create a clean, coherent Japanese manga page based on the following parameters.

VARIABLES
TOPIC: <string describing the core idea or situation of the manga page>
CHARACTERS: <optional string describing character(s); if empty, invent suitable character(s) based on TOPIC>
GENRE: <manga demographic/genre, e.g. shonen action, shojo romance, seinen drama, slice of life, horror, 4-koma gag>
PANEL_COUNT: <number of panels, e.g. 4, 5, 6, 7>
PAGE_LAYOUT: <layout approach, e.g. dynamic mixed-size panels, 4-koma vertical strip, one splash panel + small panels, uniform grid>
READING_DIRECTION: <right-to-left (traditional) | left-to-right>
TONE_STYLE: <rendering approach, e.g. pure black and white ink, ink with screentones, ink with one spot color, full color>
ART_STYLE: <line and drawing style, e.g. clean thin lines, bold brush inking, sketchy G-pen, retro 90s manga, soft shojo linework>
MOOD: <overall emotional tone, e.g. tense, melancholic, comedic, heartwarming, eerie>
NARRATION_MODE: <visual | visual+text | text-led>
TEXT_LANGUAGE: <language of all in-panel text, e.g. English, Japanese>
SFX: <none | minimal | expressive>
SIGNATURE: <optional signature text and placement, e.g. "Koda, bottom-left"; if empty, do not add a signature>

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Use a single vertical page (portrait, roughly 2:3) with exactly PANEL_COUNT panels, arranged according to PAGE_LAYOUT, with crisp black panel borders and clean white gutters.
2. Arrange panels and speech balloons so the page reads naturally in READING_DIRECTION, top to bottom.
3. Interpret TOPIC as the narrative anchor and invent a short story that unfolds across the panels.
4. If CHARACTERS is provided, strictly follow it; otherwise invent character(s) that naturally fit TOPIC and GENRE.
5. Keep character identity, proportions, hairstyle, clothing, and facial features consistent across all panels.
6. Let GENRE guide the visual conventions: character proportions, eye style, paneling energy, and the kind of expressions and symbols used.
7. Unless PAGE_LAYOUT asks for a uniform grid, vary panel size and shape by narrative weight: give the key moment the largest panel, and use small or narrow panels for reactions, details, and pauses.
8. Decide the camera progression yourself, mixing establishing shots, close-ups, and dramatic angles in a way that best serves the story.
9. Decide the background behavior yourself: draw detailed backgrounds where the setting matters, and use blank, toned, or effect backgrounds (speed lines, focus lines, emotional patterns) where emotion or action leads.
10. Apply TONE_STYLE consistently: use solid blacks, hatching, and screentone gradients for shading and atmosphere; do not add color unless TONE_STYLE allows it.
11. Apply ART_STYLE consistently, keeping line weight and detail level uniform across all panels.
12. Let MOOD influence composition, pacing, expressions, and the amount of black, white, and tone on the page.
13. Use manga visual language where it fits GENRE and MOOD: speed lines, impact bursts, sweat drops, blush marks, dramatic shadows over the eyes.
14. Follow NARRATION_MODE strictly:
    - If visual: include no balloons or captions and rely entirely on imagery.
    - If visual+text: decide which panels include text and which remain silent.
    - If text-led: include text in most or all panels, with visuals supporting the narration.
15. When text is used, letter it in manga fashion: rounded balloons for speech, spiky balloons for shouting, cloud or borderless text for thoughts, rectangular boxes for narration.
16. Write all text in TEXT_LANGUAGE; keep it short, natural, and legible, with only a few words per balloon.
17. Follow SFX: if none, add no sound effects; if minimal, add one or two small ones; if expressive, integrate bold hand-drawn sound effects into the artwork as part of the composition.
18. Ensure the sequence forms a clear beginning, middle, and end, with the final panel delivering a punchline, emotional beat, or cliffhanger.
19. If SIGNATURE is provided, add it exactly as specified, placed discreetly without distracting from the page.
20. Avoid unnecessary elements, visual clutter, and garbled or pseudo-text.
21. Ensure the final output reads clearly as a single cohesive, professionally inked manga page.

entries.author: wuyi_ai
entries.title: 10 条照片修图提示词（精修、换背景、换衣服等）
entries.note: 作者在 ChatGPT 里配合照片使用；【】处替换成自己的内容。
entries.prompt:
1/ 专业精修 

 "对这张图做专业精修，保留人物身份、五官、皮肤质感、身材比例、发型、穿着和整体观感，别修到认不出人。优化光线、清晰度、色彩平衡、曝光、对比度和整体画质。只在该去的地方去掉小杂物和瑕疵，别把皮肤修成塑料感、过度磨皮或者一眼假。"

2/ 去掉任何东西

 "把这张图里的【物体/人物】彻底去掉，真实还原它背后的区域。匹配原图的背景、光线、阴影、纹理、反光、景深、透视和周围细节，让修改区域跟整张图自然融在一起。不能出现奇怪的缺口、重复的物体、糊掉的色块，也不能让人一眼看出这里被抹过。"

3/ 换背景
  
"把现在的背景换成【新背景】，主体保持完全不变。保住人物的脸、身体、衣服、发型、姿势、比例和细节。让主体自然地融入新环境：对齐光源方向、阴影、反光、色调、景深、大小和透视，最终效果要像这张照片本来就是在那里拍的。"

4/ 画质升到 8K

 "把这张图提升到 8K，更锐、更干净、更清晰、更专业，同时保留原始构图和内容。优化细节、光线、曝光、色彩准确度、对比度、清晰度和整体通透感。减少可见噪点、模糊、压缩痕迹和发灰的颜色，但不能改变人物的脸、物体、文字、比例、背景和自然观感。"

5/ 换衣服

 "把现在的衣服换成【衣服描述】，人物身份完全不变。保住脸、发型、体型、姿势、手、肤色、比例、表情和背景。让新衣服自然地穿在身上，布料质感、褶皱、缝线、阴影、光线和动态都要真实，看起来就像人本来在原始照片里就穿着它。"

6/ 扩展画面

"把这张图向现有边界外扩展成【宽高比/尺寸】，原图范围内的内容一律不动。自然延续现有的背景、环境、地面、墙面、天空、景物、物体、光线、纹理、图案、景深和透视，铺到新增空间里。扩展要无缝，看起来就像当初拍的就是这张更大的图。"

7/ 改成另一个时间段

"把这个场景从【当前时间段】改成【日出/黄金时刻/日落/夜晚】。调整天空、光照方向、色温、反光、阴影、窗户和周围环境，让整个场景可信地符合新的时间段。"

8/ 修闭眼

"把人物闭着或半闭的眼睛修正成自然睁开的状态，与脸型、表情、视线方向、光线和眼型保持一致。修改要克制、真实，不能改变人物身份或整体表情。"

9/ 修衣服褶皱

"把衣服上分散注意力的褶皱、折痕、堆叠和不平整的布料抹顺，同时保留材质、版型、缝线、纹理和自然的褶皱。让衣服看起来整洁得体，但不能像是在图上画出来的。"

10/ 去掉自己设计稿上的文字或水印

 "把这张图里标注出来的（文字、logo、标签或图形元素）去掉，用周围的颜色、纹理、图案、光线和透视还原下面的区域。结果要干净无缝，不影响旁边的元素。"

entries.author: abxxai
entries.title: 4K 暗黑奇幻 RPG Boss 战游戏画面
entries.prompt:
Ultra-photoreal next-gen dark fantasy action RPG screenshot, captured in-game from a third-person camera behind the player at the moment a boss fight begins, indistinguishable from real engine footage.

SCENE: A vast ruined gothic cathedral with a collapsed roof open to a stormy grey sky. Broken stone pillars, shattered stained glass windows shown as dull colored shards, ash drifting through the air, candles melted onto the floor, and roots breaking through cracked flagstones. At the far end, a colossal armored knight boss, three times human height, rises from a throne of rusted swords. Its cracked helmet glows faint ember-orange from inside, and it drags a huge chipped greatsword along the floor, throwing sparks.

PLAYER CHARACTER: Lower-left third of the frame, large in frame, seen from behind. A lone warrior in battered layered plate armor, a torn dark red cloak and a dented round shield on the left arm, with a straight sword held low in the right hand. Face hidden.

GAMEPLAY HUD (minimal, classic action RPG style): thin red health bar, green stamina bar and blue focus bar top-left; a long thin boss health bar centered at the bottom of the screen with a short name in a gothic serif font above it; four small item slots in a cross shape bottom-left showing icons only.

LIGHTING: Cold diffused daylight from the broken roof, god rays cutting through ash and dust, warm ember glow from the boss and sparks, deep shadows in the side aisles, wet stone reflections.

CAMERA: 28mm wide, slightly low angle to make the boss feel huge, 16:9.

RENDER: Next-gen AAA quality, ray-traced shadows and ambient occlusion, 4K native, desaturated filmic grade, subtle grain.

AVOID: neon, bright saturated colors, logos, extra characters, cartoon look, watermarks.

entries.prompt:
16:9 landscape, 4K UHD. Using all 16 uploaded reference images, create a unified professional 3D CAD engineering presentation of PROJECT APEX X1, an original futuristic electric superbike.

Show the complete motorcycle in a large three-quarter isometric view, surrounded by its individual mechanical assemblies and engineering components.

Preserve the exact design language, proportions, geometry, materials and orange accent details from the references.

Emphasize engineering precision: visible bolts, bearings, copper windings, machined surfaces, cooling channels, internal wiring, structural supports and realistic mechanical connections.

Include smaller technical views of the motor, battery, drivetrain, suspension and cockpit.

VISUAL STYLE: Photorealistic 3D CAD rendering, advanced industrial design, professional engineering visualization, realistic PBR materials, ray-traced reflections, intricate geometry, sharp edges and exceptional micro-detail.

Clean light-grey studio background, balanced technical composition, soft professional shadows.

No duplicated components, distorted geometry, unnecessary text or watermarks.

entries.prompt:

【人物面部与五官】

一位年轻成年女性，气质冷艳、独立、自信，具有高级时装模特般的气场。脸型为精致窄鹅蛋脸，面部线条清晰，额头饱满，颧骨微微立体，下颌线优雅流畅，下巴小巧但不尖锐。

眉毛为自然深棕色平直眉，眉尾略微上挑。眼睛为狭长型杏仁狐狸眼，眼尾明显微扬，双眼皮窄而清晰，眼窝深邃立体，睫毛浓密纤长。虹膜为深灰棕色，带有细腻的琥珀色光泽，目光沉静而有力量。

鼻梁高挺笔直，鼻尖小巧精致，唇形为清晰的M形微丰唇，唇色为低饱和度玫瑰豆沙色。皮肤白皙细腻，具有自然真实的肌肤质感，采用冷调韩系高级妆容，眼妆干净利落。

【发型与发饰】

深冷巧克力棕色长发，采用高质感低扎马尾造型。头顶发丝整齐自然，顶部略微蓬松，头发从两侧向后收拢，在后脑勺下方扎成低马尾。马尾长度垂落至腰部，发尾自然形成柔和的大弧度卷曲。

额前采用轻薄偏分长刘海，一侧长碎发自然贴合脸颊，另一侧露出耳朵。使用黑色简约皮质发圈固定，不添加夸张发饰。

【服装搭配】

上身穿着一件高级炭灰色修身短款西装外套，采用挺括细腻的羊毛混纺面料，微收腰剪裁，具有清晰的西装翻领与精致肩线。内搭黑色方领修身针织背心，领口干净利落。

下身搭配黑色高腰A字西装短裙，裙长位于大腿中部，版型简洁，腰部搭配黑色细皮带与哑光银色金属扣。

外套袖口具有精致的金属纽扣，耳朵佩戴小巧银色耳圈，颈部佩戴细银色锁骨链，手腕佩戴简约银色腕表。

腿部穿着半透明深灰色丝袜，脚穿黑色厚底方头乐福鞋，鞋面配有银色金属装饰扣。

整体采用黑、炭灰、冷银三色搭配，简洁高级。

【身材比例】

高挑纤细的成年女性身材，肩线平直优美，腰部收束自然，腿部修长匀称，人体结构真实。

【四视图排版】

16:9横版构图，左侧45%展示人物正面头肩近景特写，人物端正平视镜头。右侧55%依次展示同一人物正面全身、严格90度侧面全身、背面全身。

完整呈现低马尾结构、西装肩线、衣服后背剪裁、短裙后部设计、丝袜和鞋子。所有视图保持同一张脸、同一发型、同一套服装和相同配饰。

【画面品质】

Unreal Engine 5，Octane Render，高精度3D建模，真实皮肤SSS，细腻真实发丝，精致西装羊毛面料，真实金属反光，专业摄影棚柔光，电影级商业角色设定图，8K。

浅灰色无缝背景，柔和接触阴影。

画面底部中央添加小巧清晰的文字水印：怪侠一只驴。

禁止换脸、禁止改变发型、禁止视图间服装变化、禁止夸张身材、禁止多余人物、禁止背景杂物。

entries.title: 复古直闪时装杂志封面（四种配色方向）
entries.prompt:
Create one original 9:16 fashion editorial magazine cover using ONE of the four directions below. Generate each cover separately, never as a collage.

Feature an adult East Asian fashion model with a confident expression, natural skin texture, realistic hair, and believable anatomy. Use direct studio flash, defined shadows, subtle photographic grain, detailed fabrics, and authentic leather or metallic reflections.

Use a low camera angle and deliberate foreground perspective. Bring one shoe closer to the camera while keeping the face clear, the pose physically plausible, and both legs correctly connected. Keep the hands naturally positioned beside the body or on the furniture, not reaching toward the lens.

Place a large black, high-contrast serif "FORME" masthead across the top. Integrate one oversized letter into the composition, using clean overlaps between the letter, model, furniture, and footwear. Keep the face unobstructed and the letter recognizable.

Choose one direction:

1. PULSE — COLOR IN MOTION
A raspberry-red track jacket, cream knit top, pink-and-sky-blue pleated skirt, cream slouch socks, and coral sneakers. Capture a playful forward step with one shoe lifted toward the lower foreground and natural movement in the hair. Coral-pink studio background, a giant sky-blue "P," and bold black sans-serif cover lines.

2. THROUGH — BEYOND THE FRAME
An emerald blazer, ivory blouse, tailored ivory shorts, dark green socks, and coral-orange buckle pumps. The model steps through the opening of a monumental ivory "O" with visible thickness. Her front leg extends beyond its lower rim while the rear leg remains inside. Use a warm peach studio, believable support and shadows, and elegant black serif cover lines.

3. HALO — FRAME THE ATTITUDE
A pearl-silver belted mini coat dress over a black turtleneck, charcoal knee-high socks, and silver multi-strap heels. The model sits naturally on a low chrome ring-shaped stool, extending one leg diagonally toward the camera. Smoky lavender background, a giant pale-pink serif "H," and restrained editorial typography.

4. CHIC — OWN THE LINE
A pistachio-green cropped jacket, ivory silk blouse, mustard-yellow A-line skirt, cream ankle socks, and burgundy platform loafers. The model leans comfortably against an ivory geometric block, extending one leg toward the lower-right foreground. Warm ivory background, a giant peach serif "C," and refined black cover lines.

Render the selected title and subtitle clearly. Keep supporting copy minimal: "FASHION / CULTURE / FORM."

Maintain a coherent magazine identity while allowing each direction its own pose, palette, materials, and typography. Preserve realistic joints, correct hands and feet, accurate footwear, and convincing contact with the floor or furniture.

Avoid extra limbs, fused legs, distorted shoes, plastic skin, illegible text, invented barcodes, issue dates, issue numbers, or unrelated logos.

entries.prompt:
Create an extraordinarily photorealistic, breathtaking cinematic beauty portrait of an exceptionally beautiful adult European woman in her mid-twenties, reclining gracefully on a luxurious bed inside an opulent, softly candlelit bedroom. The atmosphere evokes dreamy romance, ethereal femininity, delicate vulnerability, and the nostalgic elegance of fine-art editorial photography. The final image must resemble an authentic photograph of a real living woman, never CGI, illustration, or digital artwork.

Woman and Facial Features: A stunning woman with luminous fair ivory-peach skin, delicate freckles across her nose and cheeks, softly sculpted cheekbones, a refined straight nose, naturally full rose-pink lips, and mesmerizing almond-shaped hazel-green eyes framed by long eyelashes. Her makeup features subtle champagne eyeshadow, delicate mascara, soft rosy blush, and naturally tinted pink lips. Her expression is wistful, thoughtful, and quietly romantic as she gazes dreamily toward the side. Preserve realistic skin pores, natural facial asymmetry, and authentic human anatomy.

Hair: Her extraordinarily long, thick, copper-auburn hair cascades freely over her shoulders and across the bed in magnificent, voluminous, naturally tousled waves. Rich cinnamon, rose-gold, and warm chestnut tones shimmer beneath the candlelight. Delicate ivory and blush-pink flowers are woven into a loosely gathered half-up hairstyle, while wispy strands frame her cheeks and forehead.

Outfit and Fabric: She wears an exquisite dusty-blush pink romantic couture gown crafted from delicate silk organza, embroidered tulle, and fine floral lace. The elegant, fully lined sweetheart bodice features delicate shoulder straps, intricate three-dimensional floral appliqués, and miniature pearl embellishments. Soft translucent lace sleeves rest gracefully around her upper arms, while flowing layers of embroidered fabric gather naturally across the bed. The ensemble feels ethereal, sophisticated, and beautifully feminine.

Pose and Body Language: Capture her reclining comfortably on her stomach across luxurious embroidered bedding, her upper torso gently raised and supported by one elbow. Her cheek rests softly against her hand while her other arm extends naturally across the bed. Her head tilts slightly toward the camera, with her eyes gazing thoughtfully into the distance. Her abundant auburn curls spill across her shoulders and pillows, creating a relaxed, romantic silhouette.

Setting and Atmosphere: A magnificent vintage European bedroom featuring an ornate antique headboard, luxurious champagne-ivory bedding, delicate lace pillows, and softly glowing candles. Beautiful arrangements of pale pink roses, ivory peonies, and tiny blossoms decorate the background. Subtle gilded architectural details create a dreamy, aristocratic atmosphere.

Lighting and Cinematography: Warm rose-gold candlelight combines with soft diffused window illumination, creating luminous highlights across her face, auburn hair, shoulders, and delicate floral gown. Gentle shadows sculpt her features, while dusty rose, champagne ivory, muted copper, and warm amber dominate the romantic colour palette.

Composition and Quality: Vertical 9:16 intimate cinematic editorial portrait, medium-close framing from head to waist, slightly elevated three-quarter camera perspective. Professional full-frame photography, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, authentic skin texture, individually defined curls, realistic lace embroidery, subtle analogue film grain, and breathtaking photographic realism.

Essential Requirement: A genuine luxury romantic fashion photograph featuring a real adult woman. No oil painting, illustration, CGI, plastic skin, distorted anatomy.

entries.author: DeepBlueX0
entries.title: AI 文字视力表：繁体中文文字渲染测试海报
entries.model: ChatGPT Image 2.6 / Seedream 5.5 / Grok Images 2.0 / Muse Image
entries.note: 四张图从左到右依次对应上述四个模型。
entries.prompt:
AI 文字視力表 × 十五級極限字重 × 十五種高對比深色 × 全球文字拼圖地圖。
創作一張嚴格 9:16 直式文字測試海報，測試 AI 圖像模型對繁體中文、英文、數字、極細筆畫、字重變化與精密排版的生成能力。
整體融合視力表、瑞士編輯設計與極簡科技美學。暖白色背景，精緻疏朗，兼顧美感、文字準確性與極限測試價值。
【標題】
頂部清晰排列：
AI 文字視力表
AI TEXT VISION TEST
【十五級文字內容】
十五個等級由上至下排列，三組文字依序循環五輪。
L01、L04、L07、L10、L13：
深藍
DeepBlue
L02、L05、L08、L11、L14：
吉皮提圖像 2.6
ChatGPT Images 2.6
L03、L06、L09、L12、L15：
豆娘圖像5.5
Seedream 5.5
每級中文在上、英文在下，內容與拼寫準確，繁體字筆畫完整，數字、小數點、空格與英文大小寫正確。
【十五級字號與字重】
使用自然清晰的 Noto Sans TC 風格無襯線字體，中英文視覺協調。
各級目標字面高度佔整張圖片高度的比例，以及對應字重：
L01：3.2%，字重 600
L02：2.9%，字重 550
L03：2.6%，字重 500
L04：2.35%，字重 450
L05：2.1%，字重 400
L06：1.9%，字重 350
L07：1.7%，字重 300
L08：1.5%，字重 250
L09：1.35%，字重 200
L10：1.2%，字重 150
L11：1.05%，字重 100
L12：0.95%，極細視覺目標 80
L13：0.85%，極細視覺目標 60
L14：0.75%，極細視覺目標 40
L15：0.65%，極細視覺目標 20
字號與字重同步遞減，形成清楚而強烈的視覺階梯。
L01 至 L05：筆畫從明顯粗體逐漸過渡至標準字重。
L06 至 L10：筆畫快速變細，繁體字內部空隙逐漸更加開闊。
L11 至 L15：進入極限細字測試，筆畫逐級逼近髮絲線，L15 呈現全圖最纖細的可辨筆畫。
字重變化必須體現在字形的實際筆畫寬度。保持實心、銳利、完整的筆畫輪廓，維持足夠色彩對比。
極細效果透過真實筆畫變細呈現，保持完整字形結構。
100 以下的數值作為超越常規字體字重範圍的視覺挑戰目標，追求清楚可見的極細線條差異。
【排列方式】
十五級標籤 L01 至 L15 固定在左側，以小號中性灰色文字垂直對齊。
右側為主要測試區，每級中文在上、英文在下，所有文字從同一條左側基準線開始排列。
每條中文與英文行根據字號和內容長度自然重複，組與組之間保留清楚間距。
每行持續向右延伸，超出畫面右側邊界，由右邊界直接裁切最後一組文字。每行開頭保持完整。
隨著字號縮小，每行可容納更多重複文字，形成由大到小、由粗到細、由疏到密的視力表節奏。
保持自然字距、行距和筆畫間隙，避免繁體字內部結構黏連。
【十五級深色純色配色】
十五個等級分別使用不同的高對比深色純色。
每級中文、英文、數字與版本號使用完全一致的純色，整個字形保持均勻、不透明的實心色彩。
L01：午夜海軍藍#102A56
L02：深緋紅#981B2B
L03：焦赭橙#9C3D0A
L04：深森林綠#14532D
L05：深紫羅蘭#581C87
L06：深孔雀青#07575B
L07：深栗棕#713F12
L08：深莓紅#9D174D
L09：深酒紅#701A25
L10：皇家深藍#1D4ED8
L11：深靛紫#43318C
L12：墨綠#064E3B
L13：深鈷藍#1E40AF
L14：深梅紫#6B216B
L15：深石油藍#164E63
所有文字均採用純色平面填充，不使用漸變、透明度變化、發光、陰影或模糊。
十五種顏色在暖白背景上保持良好對比，具有清楚的色相差異。
尤其 L11 至 L15，維持深色、高對比與完整筆畫輪廓，讓極細字重的真實線條寬度成為測試重點。
字號百分比、字重數值及色碼只用於版面控制，不印在海報上。
【全球文字拼圖地圖】
在標題下方、文字測試區上方，安排一幅橫向展開的平面世界地圖。
各大洲由相互連接的不規則拼圖塊構成，主要國家和地區依照實際地理位置排列，海洋保留暖白留白。
地圖以半透明淡藍、淡紫、淺綠、暖橙構成，具有輕盈的幾何拼圖美感。
在對應地區自然點綴當地文字：
中國：中
美國：A
日本：あ
韓國：한
印度：अ
泰國：ก
沙烏地阿拉伯：ع
希臘：Ω
俄羅斯：Ж
字符位置符合地理關係，大小與拼圖板塊協調，保持清楚可辨。
地圖邊緣散落少量錯開的拼圖塊，周圍適量加入 ∞、≈、△、十字準星、圓點和方位箭頭。
地圖與裝飾保持輕盈，避免干擾文字測試。
【整體版面】
嚴格使用寬高比 9:16 的直式畫布，整張圖片完整填滿畫布。

EMOTIONAL TONE: The image should communicate tenderness, economic hardship, and human dignity through body language only. A small everyday moment that feels like a frame from a great film.  STRICT CONSTRAINTS: Only one father and one daughter. No other people anywhere in the image. No modern cars. No modern clothing. No smartphones. No fantasy elements. No exaggerated expressions. entries.prompt:
Cinematic live-action film still, Southern Song dynasty China, the Lin'an canal lock at dusk, first sleet of early winter.

A lean Han Chinese man in his early thirties, a traveling county inspector, is placed hard at the corner of the frame on the wet dark flagstones of a covered wharf — strong corner composition, leaving the other half of the frame open to the river surface and drifting water mist. He does not look at the camera. His gaze falls beyond the folded yellow mulberry-bark paper in his hands; his expression is restrained, weary yet resolute, rain beads on his lashes, faint white breath in the cold air. He wears a dark gray cross-collar narrow-sleeved lanshan robe (authentic Song-style civilian robe, not Tang, not Ming), the hem darkened by soaked water, a leather belt, a plain black lacquered scabbard at his waist, and a rain-soaked soft gauze futou headwear (Song-style soft-footed cap, not a hard official hat). In his left hand he steadies a shallow-bodied Ru ware celadon bowl — powder-blue glaze with fine crackle, rain droplets beading on the glaze. His right hand has just pressed a square stone seal; the cinnabar-red ink impression on the paper is clearly legible, bearing the two Chinese characters "临安" (Lin'an).

Behind him, a young clerk in an aged blue-beige beizi (Song-style straight-backed jacket) holds an old oil-paper umbrella, half his face buried in shadow. In the mid-ground, a boatman in coarse hemp cloth stands on a cargo boat, both hands gripping a long bamboo pole, the oilcloth cargo cover glossy with wetness, not looking at the inspector. In the far distance: a stone arch bridge spans the dark water, its reflection shattered by sleet; layered tiled rooftops fade like an ink wash; a distant pagoda dissolves into fog; under the eaves of a waterside pavilion, two oil lamps have just been lit.

Cold overcast dusk light mingles with warm amber lamplight on his cheekbones, the wet stone, and the celadon glaze; volumetric sleet drifts diagonally through the lamp beams. Eye-level 50mm anamorphic lens, horizontal pale-blue lens flare, oval bokeh, 21:9 ultra-wide cinema aspect (close to 2.39:1), shallow depth of field, his face, hands, the seal, and the bowl kept in sharp focus. Fine 35mm film grain. Restrained Song palette: ink black, blue-gray, powder celadon, cinnabar, wet wood, pale lamp amber. Real skin texture, anatomically believable hands, tactile silk, lacquer, porcelain, hemp, wet stone, paper fiber.

No modern objects, no Qing dynasty queue, no Japanese kimono, no Tang palace pageantry, no anime style, no illustration, no glowing fantasy weapons, no magazine airbrushed skin, no English text, no watermark.
